about.title: About
about.summary: Full-Stack Software Engineer with 2+ years of experience building and maintaining production-grade, scalable web applications using React, Next.js, Angular, Node.js, and REST APIs. Skilled in frontend feature ownership, clean modular UI architecture, API integrations, cloud deployment (AWS/GCP), and AI-assisted development. Experienced in supporting live systems in remote, Agile teams, delivering end-to-end solutions for enterprise and internal tools.

aboutMe.description2: of experience building production-grade applications that scale. I specialize in MERN stack, AI integrations, and AWS cloud deployments, delivering systems used in real business environments.

aboutMe.whyWorkWithMeDesc: I help startups and remote teams build systems that actually work under real users and data, with full feature ownership and long-term maintainability.

faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.description: Answers to common questions about working with me, project timelines, and remote collaboration.
faq.noFAQs: No FAQs found in this category.
faq.answer1: I work on hourly, daily, or fixed-price project agreements, depending on project scope and client needs.
faq.answer2: Yes, I am happy to sign NDAs to ensure your project and data remain secure.
faq.question3: Can you work with remote teams?
faq.answer3: Absolutely. I specialize in remote-first, async-friendly workflows across time zones.
faq.question4: What time zones do you work in?
faq.answer4: I'm flexible and can coordinate with clients in UTC ±12, with priority for Europe, USA, and Asia collaborations.
faq.question5: What is your typical project timeline?
faq.answer5: MVPs usually take 4–6 weeks. Full-scale systems depend on complexity; I provide clear milestones upfront.
faq.question6: Do you provide ongoing support after launch?
faq.answer6: Yes, I stay involved until systems are stable post-launch and offer optional maintenance plans.
faq.question7: Which tech stacks do you specialize in?
faq.answer7: React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, MERN stack, FastAPI, AWS/GCP cloud, and AI-assisted solutions.
faq.question8: Can you integrate AI features into projects?
faq.answer8: Yes, I build AI/ML-powered features where it adds real business value, using LLMs, OpenAI APIs, and custom models.
faq.question9: How do you communicate with clients?
faq.answer9: Via async updates, Slack, email, or video calls. I document progress and maintain transparency at all stages.
faq.question10: What types of projects do you take?
faq.answer10: Startups shipping MVPs, enterprise platforms, remote team collaborations, AI-powered tools, or scalable web applications.
